vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At HEAD 6cb7254b854b1f69c9e13775481e6aac79972424, authenticated add/update actions persist caller-controlled IMAP host and port; testEmailConnectionAction passes them to testImapConnection, and fetchMessages/testImapConnection both pass buildImapConfig(config) to imaps.connect. buildImapConfig copies host and port without a destination or port guard, creating the claimed TCP SSRF sink. CVE-2026-78061 is PUBLISHED, issue #148 is open, and there is no contrary vendor disposition.

atomic_bic.evidence: Public PR #100 member b41fb0bba679046c5c52a22cbd580a31cd5b3cd0 is the smallest reconstructed commit that adds lib/email-sync/imap-client.ts, including unvalidated host/port passthrough and both imaps.connect calls. Later commits only wire callers or make unrelated type/attachment edits to this file.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC has sole parent 7934025e35cffb65f1d285a6af6dae2e8514ddef. That parent has no lib/email-sync/imap-client.ts and no buildImapConfig or imaps.connect implementation; the vulnerable network sink is therefore absent.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: GitHub exposes all 20 ordered PR #100 member commits. Their final member 4c4056b7ec9c0e6ad48660b6d2549a0f04bfe614 has tree 6d003a4b7a877e9d30ad64131c8d9ff5024754fe, identical to PR #100 squash 1f655c71f2d8c35f3e30de0788b73f04e3fc8527 and main-line PR #102 squash 0bed4a6e8488ef1812e2340d5f361037c33eed84. This independently locates b41fb0b inside the aggregate rather than treating either squash as the BIC.

affected_release_membership.evidence: Main-line carrier 0bed4a6e8488ef1812e2340d5f361037c33eed84 is an ancestor of tags v0.8.0, v0.8.1, and v0.8.2 named by the CVE. Each tag contains lib/email-sync/imap-client.ts blob cfe3b19919677fd7b688ccfab860c3c7a753c601 with the vulnerable sink; v0.7.0 lacks the file.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: No fixed release exists. Later tag v0.8.5 and HEAD contain the same vulnerable imap-client.ts blob cfe3b19919677fd7b688ccfab860c3c7a753c601 as v0.8.0-v0.8.2, and no destination-validation guard exists on the default branch.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: Issue #148 and PR #170 are open; PR #170 head 939f113a5fa886d4326d5affe279cb5347b0f02c is not an ancestor of HEAD. Thus fix_sha and direct_fix_sha correctly remain null and the case is verified unpatched. The primary's suggested remediation evidence nevertheless needs the correction recorded below.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object and GitHub commit record identify Eugene Burmakin/Freika as a User author and committer, with subject 'feat: imap-simple + mailparser client wrapper', no body or trailers, no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/Made-with marker, no bot identity, and no signature payload. AI signals on later squash or repository commits are not transferred to this BIC, supporting NOT_AI.

findings: The vulnerability, atomic BIC b41fb0bba679046c5c52a22cbd580a31cd5b3cd0, parent absence, release exposure, unpatched state, and BIC-only human attribution independently support the primary NOT_AI verdict.

The primary inaccurately says PR #170 connects only to the validated target and presents its tip as a suitable remediation reference. PR #170 discards validateImapTarget's resolvedIps and then calls imaps.connect with the hostname, allowing a second DNS resolution; it also permits a DNS response containing both public and private addresses because it rejects only when no public address exists. The proposal therefore does not establish DNS-rebinding closure as claimed.

corrected_fields.unpatched.potential_fix.approach: Before save and every connection, restrict ports to 143/993, resolve the hostname, reject the target if any candidate address is loopback, link-local, private, reserved, or otherwise non-global, and bind the actual socket connection to the exact validated address while preserving the original hostname for TLS SNI and certificate verification.
corrected_fields.unpatched.potential_fix.rationale: Rejecting every non-global resolution and pinning the connection to a validated address closes both direct private-address SSRF and the validate-then-resolve DNS-rebinding gap.

remaining_gap: The project remains unpatched: no merged fix or fixed release is available, and open PR #170 does not bind imaps.connect to its validated DNS result or reject every non-global answer.
